Government Action Temporarily Blocked; Appeal Pending

A district court has granted a TRO, PI, or Section 705 Stay, pausing the government action; the government has appealed, but the appellate court has not yet issued a decision. The block remains in effect during this period until the appellate court orders otherwise.
Government Action Blocked; Appeal Pending

A district court has blocked the government action on the merits; the government has appealed, but the appellate court has not yet issued a decision. The block remains in effect during this period until the appellate court orders otherwise.
Government Action Temporarily Blocked; Appellate Court Affirmed Block

A district court had temporarily paused the government action via a TRO, PI, or Section 705 Stay; the government appealed, and the appellate court affirmed that block. The government action remains paused while the litigation continues.
Government Action Blocked; Appellate Court Affirmed Block
A district court had blocked the government action on the merits; the government appealed, and the appellate court affirmed that block. The government action remains blocked.
Case Closed in Favor of Plaintiff(s)

The case has concluded, and the plaintiff(s) largely obtained the result they sought. Temporary Block of Government Action Denied

A district court has denied a request for a TRO, PI, or Section 705 Stay, or the TRO, PI, or Section 705 Stay request was denied or dissolved as moot (including where underlying claims were dismissed on a partial ruling); the government action may continue while the litigation proceeds.
Block of Government Action Denied
A district court has denied a request to block the government action on the merits; the government action may proceed.
Temporary Block of Government Action Denied; Appeal Pending

A district court has denied a request for a TRO, PI, or Section 705 Stay; the plaintiff(s) have appealed, but the appellate court has not yet issued a decision. The government action may continue during this period until the appellate court orders otherwise.
Block of Government Action Denied; Appeal Pending

A district court has denied a request to block the government action on the merits; the plaintiff(s) have appealed, but the appellate court has not yet issued a decision. The government action may proceed during this period until the appellate court orders otherwise.
Government Action Temporarily Unblocked by Appellate Court

A district court had temporarily paused the government action via a TRO, PI, or Section 705 Stay (see Government Action Temporarily Blocked) and an appellate court has paused the effect of the district court order(s), allowing the government to continue the action while appellate review proceeds. A district court had blocked the government action on the merits; the government appealed, and the appellate court reversed or vacated the district court’s decision. The government action may proceed.
Case Closed/Dismissed in Favor of Government

The case has concluded, and the challenged government action remains in place. Government Action Blocked in Part; Block Denied in Part
A court has ruled on the merits, blocking the government action in some respects but not others.
Government Action Blocked in Part; Block Denied in Part; Appeal Pending

A court has granted a permanent injunction as to some claims or parties, but denied it as to others; one of the parties has appealed, but the appellate court has not yet issued a decision. The court ruling remains in effect during this period until the appellate court orders otherwise.
Case Closed; Split Outcome

The case has concluded without a full victory for either party. This case status may reflect a settlement in which both parties made substantive concessions, or a final court ruling that resolved the case partially in favor of each party.
Case Closed

The case has concluded without a clear win or loss for either party.
